attempts.text:
**The window starts at `relA`.** Column 0 is a spine column, carried by 100% of chromosomes, persistent, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls; the model names it in 100% of calls with 0.05 bits. Then columns 1 to 2, `mazE` and `mazF`, [[type II toxin-antitoxin system]], variable, in a region of plasticity in 0% of calls.

**A fork opens at `ygcG`.** Columns 6 to 7 are fork columns, in a region of plasticity in 91 to 92% of calls; the model names 75 to 85% there, fewest at column 6, 75%, with 1.86 bits, the window's most hesitant column. Column 8, `queE`, is a spine column in a region of plasticity in 92% of calls, the stretch most in regions of plasticity.

**Then a variable stretch follows**, columns 9 to 15, in a region of plasticity in 82 to 92% of calls, carried by 86 to 90% of chromosomes, all shell: `ygcE` to `ygcQ`, [[carbohydrate transport and oxidation]]. The model names 87 to 97% there, fewest at column 9, 87%, with 1.05 bits. Columns 16 to 17, `ygcP` and `ygcO`, are spine columns, and column 18, `ygcN`, is variable.

**A fork and variable stretch runs from column 23 to 30**, in a region of plasticity in 42 to 61% of calls; the model names 65 to 96%, fewest at column 24, 65%, with 1.18 bits. A second branch of 6 families, `cas3` to `cas6e`, [[type I-E CRISPR-associated genes]], is carried by 18 to 29% of chromosomes. Columns 31 to 43, `iap` to `rpoS`, are spine, named in 94 to 98%.

**The window ends in a long spine**, columns 53 to 68, `ygbA` to `hycI`, [[formate hydrogenlyase and hydrogenase maturation]], named in 79 to 95%, fewest at column 65, 79%. Columns 69 to 79 are fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 4 to 5% of calls, named in 92 to 96%; a second branch of 4 families, `srlE` to `pncC`, is carried by 17 to 30% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.68 against 0.17 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 95%.

label: relA
facts:
WINDOW: the relA window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor relA, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 949 to 1,028 from dnaA. Read in 539 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying relA once); 43,120 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 92% of genes, 0.32 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 29,024 calls, named 96%, 0.14 bits; shell 13,740 calls, named 84%, 0.64 bits; cloud 356 calls, named 31%, 2.67 bits. Outside an RGP 30,449 calls, named 95%, 0.17 bits; inside an RGP 12,671 calls, named 85%, 0.68 bits. Columns: 42 spine, 19 fork, 19 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.68 against 0.17 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 95%); 12,671 of the 43,120 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 6 (ygcG) 1.86 bits, RGP 91%; column 24 ("transposase") 1.18 bits, RGP 59%; column 9 (ygcE) 1.05 bits, RGP 92%. The 21 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 87%, 0.59 bits on average; the other 59 columns: named 94%, 0.22 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 8 (spine), RGP 92%; the least: column 0 (spine), RGP 0%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: relA. named 100%; 0.05 bits.
2. columns 1-2 (2 columns) variable: RGP 0%. named 88-99.8% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 1, named 88%, 0.46 bits.
   1: mazE S 84%
   2: mazF S 84%
3. columns 3-5 (3 columns) spine: share 95-96%, all P, RGP 0.4-12%. Genes: mazG "nucleoside triphosphate pyrophospho…", pyrG, eno. named 89-99% (mean 96%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 4 (pyrG), named 89%, 0.20 bits.
4. columns 6-7 (2 columns) fork: RGP 91-92%. named 75-85% (mean 80%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 6, named 75%, 1.86 bits.
   6: ygcG S 71% "TPM domain-containing protein"; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 23%, "TPM domain-containing protein" S 13%
   7: yqcG S 49%; also "hypothetical protein" S 19%
5. column 8 spine: share 95%, all P, RGP 92%. Genes: queE. named 87%; 0.69 bits.
6. columns 9-15 (7 columns) variable: RGP 82-92%. named 87-97% (mean 92%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 9, named 87%, 1.05 bits.
   columns 9-15, share 86-90%, all S: ygcE "FGGY family carbohydrate kinase" 87%, yqcE "MFS transporter" 87%, ygcW "SDR family oxidoreductase" 86%, ygcU "FAD-binding oxidoreductase" 87%, ygcS "MFS transporter" 88%, ygcR "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 90%, ygcQ "electron transfer flavoprotein subu…" 88%
7. columns 16-17 (2 columns) spine: share 90-93%, 1 S, 1 P, RGP 27-63%. Genes: ygcP "glycerol-3-phosphate responsive ant…", ygcO "ferredoxin family protein". named 95-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 17 (ygcO), named 95%; no column of this stretch hesitates more than 0.19 bits (column 17 (ygcO)).
8. column 18 variable: RGP 16%. named 97%; 0.20 bits.
   18: ygcN P 89% "FAD-dependent oxidoreductase"
9. columns 19-22 (4 columns) spine: share 95%, all P, RGP 13-30%. Genes: queD, cysJ, cysI "NADPH-dependent assimilatory sulfit…", cysH. named 87-97% (mean 93%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 22 (cysH), named 87%, 0.46 bits.
10. columns 23-30 (8 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 42-61%. named 65-96% (mean 83%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 24, named 65%, 1.18 bits.
   a second branch of 6 families through columns 23-28, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 18-29%, all S; the branch's families: cas3, casA, casB, cas7e, cas5e, cas6e
   23 fork: small P 63%
   24 fork: "transposase" S 28%; also cas3 S 26%
   25 fork: casA S 31%
   26 fork: casB S 32%
   27 fork: cas7e S 31% "type I-E CRISPR-associated protein…"
   28 fork: cas5e S 32%
   29 fork: cas1e S 62%; also cas6e S 32%
   30 variable: cas2e S 67%
11. columns 31-43 (13 columns) spine: share 92-95%, all P, RGP 6-45%. Genes: iap, cysD "phosphoadenosine phosphosulfate red…", cysN, cysC, ygbE "DUF3561 family protein", ftsB, ispD, ispF "2-C-methyl-D-erythritol 2,4-cyclodi…", truD, surE, pcm, nlpD, rpoS. named 94-98% (mean 97%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 43 (rpoS), named 94%, 0.35 bits.
12. columns 44-49 (6 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 43-59%. named 90-93% (mean 92%), fewest named at column 49, named 90%; most hesitant at column 47, 0.38 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 45-48, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 26-29%, all S; the branch's families: hosA, kpdB, kpdC, kpdD
   44 variable: ygbN S 75% "GntP family transporter"
   45 fork: ygbM S 75% "TIM barrel protein"
   46 fork: ygbL S 76% "3-oxo-tetronate 4-phosphate decarbo…"
   47 fork: otnK S 73%
   48 fork: ltnD S 75%
   49 variable: ygbI S 75% "DeoR family transcriptional regulat…"
13. columns 50-51 (2 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 22-30%. Genes: pphB, mutS. named 91-92% (mean 91%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 50 (pphB), named 91%, 0.32 bits.
14. column 52 fork: RGP 17%. named 90%; 0.34 bits.
   52: "hypothetical protein" S 47%; also "hypothetical protein" S 36%
15. columns 53-68 (16 columns) spine: share 91-94%, all P, RGP 5-13%. Genes: ygbA "nitrous oxide-stimulated promoter f…", flhA, hypE, hypD, hypC, hypB, hypA "hydrogenase/urease maturation nicke…", hycA, hycB, hycC, hycD, hycE, hycF, hycG, hycH "formate hydrogenlyase assembly prot…", hycI. named 79-95% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 65 (hycF), named 79%; most hesitant at column 63 (hycD), 0.33 bits.
16. columns 69-79 (11 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 4-5%. named 92-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 70, named 92%; most hesitant at column 69, 0.31 bits.
   a second branch of 4 families through columns 76-79, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 17-30%, all P; the branch's families: srlE, srlA, mltB, pncC
   69 variable: ascB P 85%
   70 variable: ascF P 84% "PTS transporter subunit EIIB"
   71 fork: ascG P 84%; also "type II toxin-antitoxin system HigB fam…" S 15%
   72 variable: hydN P 85%
   73 variable: hypF P 84%
   74 variable: norW P 84%
   75 variable: norV P 82% "anaerobic nitric oxide reductase fl…"
   76 fork: norR P 79%
   77 fork: gutQ P 76%
   78 fork: srlR P 72%
   79 fork: gutM P 64%; also srlD P 50%, srlB P 41%
